title: Multi-Quantum OES: offline OES replay triage workbench with an isolated AI ∩ quantum toy lab
description:
Offline, standard-library-only Python workbench for explainable OES-512 replay triage. A fixed block score (0.45·max|x| + 0.35·RMS + 0.20·mean|x|) flags a block when it is >= a preregistered threshold, and is reported alongside a per-block max-abs baseline. The workbench also includes a separate OES32 adaptive-tau stream model and 32-value residual check, offline outage-snapshot classification, metadata-only failure-capsule validation, and a loopback-only local web interface.

Version 0.1.0 adds hardening fixes with regression tests and a preregistered synthetic stress evaluation (a held-out split plus a separate calibration split). The stress result is negative: the block score does not beat the max-abs baseline at shared fixed thresholds or at thresholds calibrated to an equal false-positive rate. The release also adds a single module in which one exact statevector core powers four toy “AI ∩ quantum” applications: quantum-kernel classification (at chance on the toy data, versus a classical RBF baseline), QAOA MaxCut versus brute force, circuit compilation with full-unitary verification, and H2 VQE versus exact diagonalisation using coefficients attributed to the Qiskit tutorials (Apache-2.0).

Synthetic data only. Exact classical simulation, not QPU execution or evidence of quantum advantage, and not an operational system.
